amount.description: Its figure in the base currency: sales or spend net of GST, or the expense as the P&L shows it.

documents.description: The invoices, bills and credit notes behind it; 0 for the top expenses.

id.description: The customer, item, supplier or account; none for the rest: the lines without an item, or the expenses after the top ten.

name.description: Its name, as on file today.

quantity.description: Sales by item: the quantity sold, net of credits, in the item's unit.

share.description: Its % of the total (RND-PERCENT); empty when the total is zero.
